rules.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance (Chapter 260)
rules.requirement: Jersey City regulates rent increases on covered rental properties under its Rent Control Ordinance, administered by the Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations. Increases above the allowed amount require a landlord application, such as a capital improvement, vacancy capital improvement, or hardship application, and tenants may file Illegal Rent Petitions.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential rental properties with 5 or more units in Jersey City, unless an exemption under the ordinance applies.
rules.exemptions: All 1-4 unit properties are exempt. Other exemptions under the ordinance are available by Rent Control Exemption Request; the specific criteria are not stated on this page.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Other ordinance exemptions (criteria not stated on this page) may apply via an approved Rent Control Exemption Request.

rules.citation: Jersey City Municipal Code Chapter 260 (Rent Control Ordinance)
rules.quoted_span: (Please Note: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control)
rules.conflict_note: This summary page does not state the allowable increase formula. It references a CPI chart, which suggests a CPI-based cap, but the cap is not given here.
